refinement_boundary.claim: The route inventory and hostile tests are bound to this contract; they do not establish mathematical Python-to-TLA refinement or authorize upgrade apply/rollback.

nonclaims: This artifact does not prove Python implementation refinement.

Git authority operations, selector launch, and upgrade mutation are outside this checkpoint.
